subject: Privileged service account roles + IP allowlist kickoff
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@fintrust.com>
Cc: security@fintrust.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Privileged service account roles + IP allowlist kickoff

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our onboarding checklist, next steps for the access controls piece are focused on two items we want to lock in this week:

1) Privileged service accounts (roles & delegation) — which Redwoods SAs will be provisioned, who needs long-lived keys vs ephemeral, and the delegation boundaries.
2) IP allowlisting for the initial staging and prod CIDR ranges and any VPN exit nodes that should be whitelisted.

Can you confirm the right security contact for us to share the RBAC matrix with and an initial list of CIDR blocks? If easier, we can take an inventory call with your infra team and walk the matrix live.

I've cc'd our CS lead (Monica) and the SDR who owns the account (Ben) so we can align on timing and any procurement constraints.

Attachments: redwood-priv-sa-role-matrix.xlsx (starter), ip-allowlist-template.csv

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@fintrust.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fintrust.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Privileged service account roles + IP allowlist kickoff

Vanessa —

Appreciate the note. I’m the security lead on the project and will own coordination with our infra team. Quick answers:

- Contact: Emma Liu (me) is primary; compute infra is kev.singh@fintrust.com and network is nancy.cho@fintrust.com.
- CIDRs: staging (10.8.0.0/20), prod (10.2.0.0/20) and we have two VPN exit IPs: 34.72.11.8 and 34.72.11.9.
- Service account approach: we prefer ephemeral tokens where possible; for any long-lived accounts we need a justification and quarterly rotation plan.

A couple asks from our side before the call:
- Can you include a mapping of which Redwood service accounts will have access to customer data vs telemetry/metrics?
- Any audit log hooks or retention defaults you apply by default?

I can do a 30-min sync today at 2pm PT if that works.

Best,
Emma
Head of Security
FinTrust
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@fintrust.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, security@fintrust.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Privileged service account roles + IP allowlist kickoff

Emma —

Perfect, thank you. 2pm PT works for us. Monica, Ben — can you join the 2pm sync? Agenda I propose (25 min + 5 min buffer):

- Quick intros and scope (2m)
- Review redwood-priv-sa-role-matrix.xlsx (8m): map Redwood SAs to FinTrust resources; mark any long-lived requirements
- IP allowlist confirmation (5m): accept CIDRs and VPN exit IPs; confirm staging/prod split
- Audit/log hooks & retention defaults (6m): answer Emma’s question; note custom retention for FT if needed
- Action items and owners (4m)

I’m attaching a slightly annotated role matrix and the DocuSign provisioning SLA we typically include in enterprise contracts (docuSign-provisioning-sla.pdf).

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-priv-sa-role-matrix.xlsx (annotated), docuSign-provisioning-sla.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@fintrust.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, security@fintrust.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Privileged service account roles + IP allowlist kickoff

Hi Emma / team —

Great sync this afternoon — appreciate everyone jumping on. Recap + agreed next steps:

Recap:
- We agreed on using ephemeral session tokens for the majority of runtime service accounts. Long-lived accounts limited to non-customer-data telemetry pipelines and a small ops account for emergency runbooks.
- FinTrust provided CIDRs and VPN exit IPs (staging 10.8.0.0/20, prod 10.2.0.0/20, exits 34.72.11.8/9).
- Redwood will enable audit hooks to forward control-plane audit events to the FinTrust SIEM; default retention is 90 days but we can extend to 365 on request (additional fee).

Action items (owners & timeline):
- Vanessa: upload final role matrix with delegated principals filled and send to Emma by EOD Tue 6/1. (attachment: redwood-priv-sa-role-matrix.xlsx)
- Ben: create a single procurement line item for the provisioning SLA addendum and share with FinTrust procurement by 6/2. (attachment: docuSign-provisioning-sla.pdf)
- Monica (me): prepare short runbook for emergency ops account use and rotation cadence; deliver draft 6/3.
- Emma/FinTrust: confirm whether they want audit retention extended to 365 days and provide procurement contact for DocuSign routing by 6/2.

Attachments we shared in the call: redwood-priv-sa-role-matrix.xlsx, ip-allowlist-template.csv, docuSign-provisioning-sla.pdf

If anything above is off, flag here and I’ll update the playbook. Thanks all — looking forward to the cutover window.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
